evidence: Matches the P2P label, modifies eviction logic in `src/net_processing.cpp`, and updates `src/headerssync.h`.
rationale: Prevents premature eviction of active outbound peers during headers presync over high-latency networks like Tor and I2P. Anti-DoS headers sync does not update `pindexBestKnownBlock` during presync, causing nodes on connections where round trips exceed ~2.5 seconds to hit the 22-minute eviction threshold and repeatedly discard sync progress.
